desc:
« Demise [Alpha] »

Expect bugs, the game won't be perfect.

Roles:
Killer (Your objective is to eliminate all bystanders within before the time runs out)
Bystander (Your objective is to try and stop the killer, weapons such as knives are scattered throughout the map)

Keyboard controls:
C: Crouch
X: Stand
R: Reload
T: Chamber
Left Click: Shoot
Left Shift: Sprint
Q: Ragdoll

Gamepad controls:
B/○: Crouch
Y/△: Stand
X/□: Reload
R1: Chamber
R2: Fire
L1: Sprint
D-Pad Down/▼: Ragdoll
